3D semantic segmentation is a challenging task and there are many ways to improve it.

3DMV is the first end-to-end learning framework for 3D indoor scene segmentation from RGB-D data, which achieves the best performance to date.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose the first joint 2D3D network for 3D scene segmentation.
we propose a novel joint 3D-multi-view prediction network architecture for RGB-D 3D semantic segmentation in the context of 3D scanning.
it is the first work to combine 2D RGB and 3D geometric information in a joint network architecture for the task of 3D semantic segmentation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can achieve better performance by combining both geometric and color features in a joint 2D/3D network architecture.
3D semantic segmentation can benefit greatly from the combination of geometric and color features.
we can combine RGB images and geometric information in a joint 3d multi-view network to achieve better results than existing methods.
